blocks.text: Yeh Unit 10 (Solution of Trigonometric Equations) ke poore unit se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, unit ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal mukhtasar qadmon mein hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define a trigonometric equation and give two examples.
(Trigonometric equation (tikonmiyati muadla) ki definition likhein aur do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Trigonometric equation woh equation hai jis mein aik ya zyada trigonometric functions (ya un ke inverse) hon, maslan \(2\cos x = 1\) aur \(\tan^{2}x - 3 = 0\).

book_ref.quote: A trigonometric equation is an equation that involves one or more trigonometric functions

blocks.prompt:
2 Define the principal solutions and the general solution of a trigonometric equation.
(Trigonometric equation ke principal solutions (bunyadi hal) aur general solution (aam hal) ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Jo solutions \([0, 2\pi]\) mein hon woh principal solutions hain. Un mein period ke multiples jama ya tafreeq karne se tamam solutions milte hain, jinhein general solution kehte hain (\(n \in \mathbb{Z}\) ke saath).

book_ref.quote: adding or subtracting multiples of the period generates all possible solutions called the general solution

blocks.prompt:
3 Solve \(\tan x = -1\).
(\(\tan x = -1\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: Reference angle \(\frac{\pi}{4}\); \(\tan\) II aur IV mein negative: \(x = \frac{3\pi}{4}\), \(x = \frac{7\pi}{4}\). Period \(\pi\): general solution \(x = \frac{3\pi}{4} + n\pi\), \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\).

book_ref.quote: Reference angle from the positive value, quadrants from the sign

blocks.prompt:
4 Solve \(2\cos x - \sqrt{3} = 0\).
(\(2\cos x - \sqrt{3} = 0\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\cos x = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\); reference angle \(\frac{\pi}{6}\); I aur IV: \(x = \frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{11\pi}{6}\). General solution \(\left\{\frac{\pi}{6} + 2n\pi\right\} \cup \left\{\frac{11\pi}{6} + 2n\pi\right\}\), \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\).

book_ref.quote: Since cosine is positive, so \(x\) lies in the I and IV quadrant

blocks.prompt:
5 Solve \(\sqrt{3}\cot x + 1 = 0\).
(\(\sqrt{3}\cot x + 1 = 0\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\cot x = -\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\), yani \(\tan x = -\sqrt{3}\); reference angle \(\frac{\pi}{3}\); II aur IV: \(x = \frac{2\pi}{3}, \frac{5\pi}{3}\). Period \(\pi\): \(x = \frac{2\pi}{3} + n\pi\), \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\).

book_ref.quote: Period \(2\pi\) for \(\sin\), \(\cos\), \(\sec\), \(\csc\); period \(\pi\) for \(\tan\), \(\cot\)

blocks.prompt:
6 Solve \(\sec x = \sqrt{2}\).
(\(\sec x = \sqrt{2}\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\cos x = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\); reference angle \(\frac{\pi}{4}\); I aur IV: \(x = \frac{\pi}{4}, \frac{7\pi}{4}\). General solution \(\left\{\frac{\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\right\} \cup \left\{\frac{7\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\right\}\), \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\).

book_ref.quote: \(\cos x = \frac{1}{\sec x}\), and the reciprocal of

blocks.prompt:
7 Solve \(\csc x = -2\).
(\(\csc x = -2\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\sin x = -\frac{1}{2}\); reference angle \(\frac{\pi}{6}\); III aur IV: \(x = \frac{7\pi}{6}, \frac{11\pi}{6}\). General solution \(\left\{\frac{7\pi}{6} + 2n\pi\right\} \cup \left\{\frac{11\pi}{6} + 2n\pi\right\}\), \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\).

book_ref.quote: Since sine is negative, \(x\) lies in the III and IV quadrants with reference angle

blocks.prompt:
8 Write the general solution of (i) \(\sin x = 0\) (ii) \(\cos x = 1\) (iii) \(\cos x = -1\).
(In ka general solution likhein: (i) \(\sin x = 0\) (ii) \(\cos x = 1\) (iii) \(\cos x = -1\).)
blocks.explanation: (i) \(x = n\pi\) (ii) \(x = 2n\pi\) (iii) \(x = \pi + 2n\pi\), har jagah \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\).

book_ref.quote: Special values with no quadrant pair

blocks.prompt:
9 Solve \(4\cos^{2}x - 1 = 0\).
(\(4\cos^{2}x - 1 = 0\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: Square ko alag karein, dono nishan lein, phir har basic equation hal karein.

book_ref.quote: After \(\pm\) (square roots) solve both cases; the general solution is the union of all families.

blocks.prompt:
10 Solve \(\csc^{2}x - 2 = 0\).
(\(\csc^{2}x - 2 = 0\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: Sine mein badlein aur square root ke dono nishan rakhein.

book_ref.quote: Taking the reference angle from a negative number

blocks.final_answer: Principal solutions \(\frac{\pi}{4}, \frac{3\pi}{4}, \frac{5\pi}{4}, \frac{7\pi}{4}\); general solution \(\left\{\frac{\pi}{4} + n\pi\right\} \cup \left\{\frac{3\pi}{4} + n\pi\right\}\), \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\)

blocks.prompt:
11 Solve \(2\sin^{2}x + 3\sin x + 1 = 0\).
(\(2\sin^{2}x + 3\sin x + 1 = 0\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\sin x\) mein quadratic samajh kar factorise karein.

book_ref.quote: a product is zero only when one of its factors is zero

blocks.prompt:
12 Solve \(2\cos^{2}x + \sin x - 1 = 0\).
(\(2\cos^{2}x + \sin x - 1 = 0\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\cos^{2}x = 1 - \sin^{2}x\) laga kar \(\sin x\) mein quadratic banayein.

book_ref.quote: Reduce the equation to one or more basic equations

blocks.prompt:
13 Solve \(\sin x\cos x = \cos x\).
(\(\sin x\cos x = \cos x\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\cos x(\sin x - 1) = 0\). \(\cos x = 0\) se \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{3\pi}{2}\); \(\sin x = 1\) se \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) (pehle aa chuka). General solution \(x = \frac{\pi}{2} + n\pi\), \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\). (\(\cos x\) cancel karte to \(\frac{3\pi}{2}\) zaya ho jata.)

book_ref.quote: We do not cancel \(\cos x\); cancelling would lose the case \(\cos x = 0\).

blocks.prompt:
14 Solve \(2\cos^{2}x - \sqrt{3}\cos x = 0\).
(\(2\cos^{2}x - \sqrt{3}\cos x = 0\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\cos x(2\cos x - \sqrt{3}) = 0\). \(\cos x = 0\) se \(\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{3\pi}{2}\); \(\cos x = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) se \(\frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{11\pi}{6}\). General solution \(\left\{\frac{\pi}{2} + n\pi\right\} \cup \left\{\frac{\pi}{6} + 2n\pi\right\} \cup \left\{\frac{11\pi}{6} + 2n\pi\right\}\), \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\).

book_ref.quote: never cancel a factor that contains \(x\)

blocks.prompt:
15 Solve \(\tan x + \cot x = 2\).
(\(\tan x + \cot x = 2\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\cot x = \frac{1}{\tan x}\) likh kar fraction khatam karein.

book_ref.quote: If you squared, multiplied by a variable expression, or the equation has \(\tan\), \(\cot\), \(\sec\), \(\csc\), put every root back into the original equation.

blocks.prompt:
16 Solve \(\sin 2x = \frac{1}{2}\).
(\(\sin 2x = \frac{1}{2}\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: Pehle \(2x\) ke liye period \(2\pi\) ke saath hal karein, phir 2 se taqseem karein.

book_ref.quote: \(\sin x = k\), \(\cos x = k\) or \(\tan x = k\) (use identities, factorise; never cancel

blocks.prompt:
17 Why must every root be checked after squaring both sides of a trigonometric equation?
(Trigonometric equation ke dono taraf square karne ke baad har root check karna kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Agar \(A^{2} = B^{2}\) ho to \(A = B\) ya \(A = -B\). Is liye \(A = B\) ko square karne se \(A = -B\) bhi hal ho jati hai, aur us ke roots (extraneous roots) asal equation ko poora nahin karte. Har root ko asal equation mein rakhne se yeh nikal jate hain.

blocks.prompt:
18 Show that \(\left\{\frac{\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\right\} \cup \left\{\frac{3\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\right\} \cup \left\{\frac{5\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\right\} \cup \left\{\frac{7\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\right\}\) can be written as \(\left\{\frac{\pi}{4} + n\pi\right\} \cup \left\{\frac{3\pi}{4} + n\pi\right\}\).
(Dikhayein ke \(\left\{\frac{\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\right\} \cup \left\{\frac{3\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\right\} \cup \left\{\frac{5\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\right\} \cup \left\{\frac{7\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\right\}\) ko \(\left\{\frac{\pi}{4} + n\pi\right\} \cup \left\{\frac{3\pi}{4} + n\pi\right\}\) likha ja sakta hai.)
blocks.explanation: \(\frac{5\pi}{4} = \frac{\pi}{4} + \pi\) aur \(\frac{7\pi}{4} = \frac{3\pi}{4} + \pi\). Is liye \(\left\{\frac{\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\right\} \cup \left\{\frac{5\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\right\}\) mein \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) ke saath \(\pi\) ke juft aur taaq dono multiples hain, yani \(\left\{\frac{\pi}{4} + n\pi\right\}\); isi tarah baqi do se \(\left\{\frac{3\pi}{4} + n\pi\right\}\).

book_ref.quote: the book's form with four sets is the safer one

blocks.prompt:
19 Find all solutions of \(\sin x = \frac{1}{2}\) in the interval \([-2\pi, 2\pi]\).
(\(\sin x = \frac{1}{2}\) ke \([-2\pi, 2\pi]\) mein tamam solutions maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: General solution \(\left\{\frac{\pi}{6} + 2n\pi\right\} \cup \left\{\frac{5\pi}{6} + 2n\pi\right\}\). \(n = 0\) se \(\frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{5\pi}{6}\); \(n = -1\) se \(-\frac{11\pi}{6}, -\frac{7\pi}{6}\). Jawab: \(x = -\frac{11\pi}{6}, -\frac{7\pi}{6}, \frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{5\pi}{6}\).

book_ref.quote: For \(n = 1\) we get \(\frac{\pi}{3} + 2\pi = \frac{7\pi}{3}\)

blocks.prompt:
20 Describe the graphical method of solving \(f(x) = g(x)\).
(\(f(x) = g(x)\) ko graph se hal karne ka tareeqa bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(y = f(x)\) aur \(y = g(x)\) ko aik hi axes par aik hi scale se banayein. Jahan curves aik doosre ko kaatein, us point ka \(x\)-coordinate \(f(x) = g(x)\) ka solution hai.

book_ref.quote: plotting the graphs of both sides of the equation and identifying their points of intersection

blocks.prompt:
21 Why is \(x\) measured in radians when \(\cos x = \frac{x}{3}\) is solved graphically?
(\(\cos x = \frac{x}{3}\) ko graph se hal karte waqt \(x\) radians mein kyun napte hain?)
blocks.explanation: \(x\) cosine ke bahar \(\frac{x}{3}\) mein bhi hai. Yeh tabhi theek hai jab zaviya real number ho, yani radians mein; degrees mein line aur curve alag scale par hon ge.

book_ref.quote: Always measure \(x\) in radians

blocks.prompt:
22 Find the interval that contains all real solutions of \(\sin x = \frac{x}{6}\).
(\(\sin x = \frac{x}{6}\) ke tamam real solutions kis interval mein hain?)
blocks.explanation: \(-1 \le \sin x \le 1\) se \(-1 \le \frac{x}{6} \le 1\), yani \(-6 \le x \le 6\). Tamam solutions \([-6, 6]\) mein hain.

book_ref.quote: If no interval is given, use the range of the trigonometric side

blocks.prompt:
23 Use the sign test to show that \(\cos x = x\) has a root between \(0\) and \(1\).
(Sign test se dikhayein ke \(\cos x = x\) ka aik root \(0\) aur \(1\) ke darmiyan hai.)
blocks.explanation: \(f(x) = \cos x - x\). \(f(0) = 1 > 0\) aur \(f(1) \approx -0.4597 < 0\). Nishan badalta hai, is liye \(y = \cos x\) aur \(y = x\) ke graphs \(0\) aur \(1\) ke darmiyan katte hain.

book_ref.quote: To improve a reading, use the sign test

blocks.prompt:
24 How many real solutions does \(\sin x = \frac{x}{3}\) have? Give reasons.
(\(\sin x = \frac{x}{3}\) ke kitne real solutions hain? Wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Sine ki range se interval mehdood karein, x > 0 par crossings ginein, phir symmetry lagayein.

book_ref.quote: Use symmetry (odd functions) and periodicity

steps: \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) par \(1 > 0.52\); \(3\) par \(\sin 3 \approx 0.14 < 1\). \(\left[\frac{\pi}{2}, 3\right]\) par curve neeche aur line oopar jati hai: sirf aik crossing (\(x \approx 2.28\)); \(\left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) par curve line se oopar rehta hai
Dono taraf odd functions hain, is liye \(x \approx -2.28\) bhi solution hai

blocks.prompt:
25 Show that \(x = 0\) is not a solution of \(\cos x = \frac{x}{5}\).
(Dikhayein ke \(x = 0\), \(\cos x = \frac{x}{5}\) ka solution nahin hai.)
blocks.explanation: \(x = 0\) par \(\cos 0 = 1\) magar \(\frac{0}{5} = 0\). \(1 \ne 0\), is liye dono graphs \(x = 0\) par nahin milte (sirf line origin se guzarti hai).

book_ref.quote: Counting a point where only one graph passes

blocks.prompt:
26 Write the vertical asymptotes of \(y = \tan x\) in \([-\pi, \pi]\) and say why they cannot be solutions of \(\tan x = \frac{x}{4}\).
(\([-\pi, \pi]\) mein \(y = \tan x\) ke vertical asymptotes likhein aur batayein ke yeh \(\tan x = \frac{x}{4}\) ke solutions kyun nahin ho sakte.)
blocks.explanation: \(x = \pm\frac{\pi}{2}\) par \(\cos x = 0\), is liye asymptotes \(x = -\frac{\pi}{2}\) aur \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) hain. Wahan \(\tan x\) defined nahin, is liye yeh equation ko poora nahin kar sakte.

book_ref.quote: always draw the asymptotes first as dashed lines

blocks.prompt:
27 Between which values does \(y = 2\cos x + 1\) move? Give its values at \(x = 0, \frac{\pi}{2}, \pi\).
(\(y = 2\cos x + 1\) kin values ke darmiyan rehta hai? \(x = 0, \frac{\pi}{2}, \pi\) par us ki values likhein.)
blocks.explanation: \(2\cos x\) \(-2\) aur \(2\) ke darmiyan; \(1\) jama karne se \(-1 \le y \le 3\). \(x = 0, \frac{\pi}{2}, \pi\) par \(y = 3, 1, -1\).

book_ref.quote: the number in front stretches the wave vertically (amplitude)

blocks.prompt:
28 A graph shows a root of \(\sin x = \frac{x}{3}\) near \(2.25\). Show that the root lies between \(2.2\) and \(2.3\).
(Graph \(\sin x = \frac{x}{3}\) ka aik root \(2.25\) ke qareeb dikhata hai. Dikhayein ke root \(2.2\) aur \(2.3\) ke darmiyan hai.)
blocks.explanation: \(f(x) = \sin x - \frac{x}{3}\). \(f(2.2) \approx 0.0752 > 0\); \(f(2.3) \approx -0.0210 < 0\). Nishan badalta hai, is liye root \(2.2\) aur \(2.3\) ke darmiyan hai (\(x \approx 2.279\)).

book_ref.quote: The exact values can be refined using numerical methods

blocks.prompt:
29 Using graphs, explain why \(2\sin x = 3\) has no solution.
(Graph ki madad se samjhayein ke \(2\sin x = 3\) ka koi solution kyun nahin.)
blocks.explanation: Equation \(\sin x = \frac{3}{2}\) hai. \(y = \sin x\) ka graph \(y = -1\) aur \(y = 1\) ke darmiyan hai, jab ke \(y = \frac{3}{2}\) us se oopar ufqi line hai. Yeh kabhi nahin katte, is liye koi solution nahin.

book_ref.quote: Each point where the curves intersect represents a solution to the equation.

blocks.prompt:
30 A tower 25 m high stands on level ground. Find the angle of elevation of its top from a point \(25\sqrt{3}\) m from its foot.
(25 m ooncha minar hamwar zameen par hai. Us ke qadam se \(25\sqrt{3}\) m door nuqte se choti ka angle of elevation (bulandi ka zaviya) maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\tan\theta = \frac{25}{25\sqrt{3}} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\), is liye \(\theta = \tan^{-1}\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = 30^{\circ}\).

book_ref.quote: In each right triangle write

blocks.prompt:
31 The angle of elevation of the top of a pole from a point 15 m from its foot is \(45^{\circ}\). Find the height of the pole.
(Khambe ke qadam se 15 m door nuqte se us ki choti ka angle of elevation \(45^{\circ}\) hai. Khambe ki oonchai maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\tan 45^{\circ} = \frac{h}{15}\), is liye \(h = 15\) m.

book_ref.quote: an angle at the observer is \(\tan^{-1}\frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{adjacent}}\)

blocks.prompt:
32 Write \(\tan^{-1}3 - \tan^{-1}1\) as a single inverse tangent.
(\(\tan^{-1}3 - \tan^{-1}1\) ko aik inverse tangent ki shakal mein likhein.)

book_ref.quote: turns the difference into one inverse tangent

blocks.prompt:
33 A stone is thrown with \(v_0 = 20\) m/s. Using \(R = \frac{v_0^{2}}{g}\sin 2\theta\) with \(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\), find the maximum range and the angle that gives it.
(Pathar \(v_0 = 20\) m/s se phenka jata hai. \(R = \frac{v_0^{2}}{g}\sin 2\theta\) aur \(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\) se maximum range aur us ka angle maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(R\) sab se bara jab \(\sin 2\theta = 1\), yani \(\theta = 45^{\circ}\). \(R_{\max} = \frac{400}{9.8} \approx 40.82\) m.

book_ref.quote: The range is maximized when \(\sin 2\theta\) is maximized.

blocks.prompt:
34 Show that the launch angles \(\theta\) and \(90^{\circ} - \theta\) give the same range \(R = \frac{v_0^{2}}{g}\sin 2\theta\).
(Dikhayein ke launch angles \(\theta\) aur \(90^{\circ} - \theta\) aik hi range \(R = \frac{v_0^{2}}{g}\sin 2\theta\) dete hain.)
blocks.explanation: \(90^{\circ} - \theta\) ke liye \(\sin 2(90^{\circ} - \theta) = \sin(180^{\circ} - 2\theta) = \sin 2\theta\). Is liye dono angles par \(R\) barabar hai.

book_ref.quote: Complementary launch angles always give the same range

blocks.prompt:
35 Find the range of a ball thrown at \(30^{\circ}\) with \(v_0 = 14\) m/s (\(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\)), using \(R = \frac{v_0^{2}}{g}\sin 2\theta\).
(\(30^{\circ}\) par \(v_0 = 14\) m/s se phenki gayi gaind ki range \(R = \frac{v_0^{2}}{g}\sin 2\theta\) (\(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\)) se maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(R = \frac{196}{9.8}\sin 60^{\circ} = 20 \cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = 10\sqrt{3} \approx 17.32\) m.

book_ref.quote: keep only the answers that make physical sense

blocks.prompt:
36 A 5 m flagpole stands on top of a 20 m building. Find the angle the flagpole subtends at a point on the ground 20 m from the foot of the building.
(20 m oonchi imarat ki chhat par 5 m ka jhanday ka danda hai. Imarat ke qadam se 20 m door zameen par nuqte par danda kitna zaviya banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Danday ki choti tak ke zaviye mein se us ke neeche tak ka zaviya tafreeq karein.

book_ref.quote: The angle an object subtends (between the lines to its bottom and its top) is a difference of two such angles.

steps: Choti tak: \(\tan^{-1}\frac{25}{20} = \tan^{-1}\frac{5}{4}\); danday ke neeche tak: \(\tan^{-1}1\)

blocks.prompt:
37 A 10 m ladder leans against a vertical wall and reaches 8 m up the wall. Find the angle the ladder makes with the ground.
(10 m lambi seerhi seedhi deewar se lagi hai aur deewar par 8 m oopar tak pohanchti hai. Seerhi zameen ke saath kitna zaviya banati hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\sin\theta = \frac{8}{10} = 0.8\), is liye \(\theta = \sin^{-1}0.8 \approx 53.13^{\circ}\) (acute angle, jaisa hona chahiye).

book_ref.quote: gives the angle in \([-90^{\circ}, 90^{\circ}]\) whose sine is

blocks.prompt:
38 With \(v_0 = 20\) m/s and \(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\), can a projectile reach a target (i) 30 m away (ii) 50 m away? Use \(R = \frac{v_0^{2}}{g}\sin 2\theta\).
(\(v_0 = 20\) m/s aur \(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\) ke saath kya projectile (i) 30 m (ii) 50 m door nishane tak pohanch sakta hai? \(R = \frac{v_0^{2}}{g}\sin 2\theta\) istemal karein.)
blocks.explanation: (i) \(\sin 2\theta = \frac{30 \times 9.8}{400} = 0.735\), jo 0 aur 1 ke darmiyan hai: haan. (ii) \(\sin 2\theta = \frac{50 \times 9.8}{400} = 1.225 > 1\): na-mumkin, is liye nishane tak nahin pohanch sakta (\(R_{\max} \approx 40.82\) m).

book_ref.quote: The value is between 0 and 1, so solutions exist.
